name: web-greyscale-portrait-collage-with-staggered-tiles-and-name-list
title: Team section with four staggered greyscale portrait tiles at the left and a list of six names with tracked caps roles at the right
whatItIs: A white page with four rounded black-and-white portraits at staggered heights, two with broken image alt text overlaying, and at the right a vertical list of six people, each with a small grey marker, a medium sans name and a wide-tracked grey caps role (Director of Photography, Founder, Lead Front-End, Product Owner, CTO - Product Designer, Make-Up Artiste).
whatItMeans: Editorial and calm; staggered greyscale tiles and a tracked list feel like a credits page.
techniques: Stagger portrait tiles in a loose collage.
Pair with a clean name list.

vocabulary.definition: A list of names with roles.
Uppercase text with wide letter spacing.
